name: ORKS: WARBIKERS
description:
Ork Warbikers ride rumbling kustom attack bikes armed with rapid-firing dakkaguns, spraying the foe with ragged bursts of shells as the bike bucks wildly under the reckless riders. As they close in, the spikes and crude blades mounted to their bikes cut a bloody trail through enemy units, while the riders hack what’s left with choppas.

The Mainstay of the Kults of Speed

This multipart plastic kit builds 3 Warbikers, fast and deadly mounted warriors for your Ork armies in games of Warhammer 40,000. Each bike is a heavily modified and personalised steed with jagged armour plates, jutting tailpipes, and chunky tyres, armed with dual dakkaguns mounted to the front. The Biker Nob is equipped with a dual combi-rokkit for added firepower. If you're looking for a fast unit that's effective both at range and in melee, these brutal bikers are for you.

Kustomise Your Warbikes

One of the riders can be assembled as an optional Biker Nob, with 2 boss poles and 2 different heads to choose from, unique arms, larger tailpipes, a distinctive front armour plate, handlebars, and rokkits. This versatile kit also includes several interchangeable parts, allowing you to customise your Warbikers in a variety of ways.

Interchangeable parts:
– 3 front-wheel forks
– 3 sets of guns
– 3 handlebars
– 4 front armour plates
– 3 tailpipes
– 6 heads

Contents:
– 85 plastic components
– 3 Citadel 75mm by 41.5mm Oval Bases
– 1 construction guide
– 1 Orks Transfer Sheet

The Orks Transfer Sheet features 385 high-quality waterslide transfers. These include symbols and icons for the Goffs, Bad Moons, Snakebites, Evil Suns, Blood Axes, and Deathskulls, as well as universal Ork glyphs, symbols, and decorations.

These miniatures require assembly and are supplied unpainted. We recommend:
– Citadel Tools: Super Fine Detail Cutters
– Warhammer Colour Plastic Glue
– Warhammer Colour paints
